SUPERSEDED. Acceptance-evaluation enforcement is ON again: Engram since 2026-11-09 07:07:38Z and TermAl since 2026-11-10 19:43:17Z, by Greg's explicit decisions (memory rules-greg-evaluation-on-engram-2026-11-09 and rules-greg-evaluation-on-termal-2026-11-10). w-89f3b3eeb688 closed on 2026-11-11 with evaluation 67b8d487 3/3. Evaluated completion now needs a fresh independent evaluation that passes. A missing verdict stays missing, and an unavailable evaluator is never a pass. Revised by Engram::Fable, 2026-11-11, to remove the stale "enforcement OFF" instruction.

HISTORY, kept for provenance, NOT current instruction. Greg direct to Engram::Architect3, 2026-11-02: "Engram::Fable sie zatkal czekajac ma moj input / TO NIE JEST ACEPTOWALNE / independent acceptance evaluation first, / THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF / UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING". From then until the re-activations above, both projects used audited self-asserted completion (allowed_modes empty), with no evaluator pass invented. The earlier remote hybrid is in revision 2 as history. Details are on w-ed6addd812bd.
